title: Why James Sunderland came back to Silent Hill 2
subject: james
description:
Would you have gone to Silent Hill after reading that letter? 👇

How a letter from his late wife Mary pulled James Sunderland into the fog of Silent Hill. Spoilers for Silent Hill 2.

scenes.text: James Sunderland's dead wife sent him a letter.
Mary had died of an illness three years earlier. Yet her letter asked him to meet her in their special place: Silent Hill.
So James drove there alone, and found streets buried in fog and creatures that should not exist.
Then he met Maria. She had Mary's face, but none of her gentle soul.
But that's not the strangest part. Every lost soul he meets seems trapped by their own guilt.
James thought he was searching for his wife. It all started with one impossible letter.
